slots.purpose: Replace the static caption card with a kinetic, readable hook line.
rules: Highlight only the keyword or key phrase in lime.
Keep the line short enough to read on a phone screen.

slots.purpose: Show the key number cleanly and make the number the visual hero.
rules: Use lime for the key number or highlight state.
Keep contrast high on the dark background.

slots.purpose: Prove one motion transition so the reel does not feel static.
rules: Use exactly one FX in V0.
Do not stack multiple FX in the same beat.
The FX must support the story, not distract from it.

slots.purpose: End the reel with a clean call to action and the handle only on the CTA card.
rules: Handle appears only on the final CTA card.
Keep the CTA short and direct.
Make the final card read cleanly in under 2 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: One 30-45 second reel can be produced from a hand-written JSON scene plan.
The reel uses the current brand kit and Readex Pro.
The reel contains the four V0 slots above.
The reel shows one FX only.
The look is ready for Hesham to approve or request fixes.
